title: After smearing Trump for years, Comrade Karen Bass grovels for fire relief funds at the White House
text:
So let me see if I get this straight…. Comrade Karen Bass, one of many corrupt Democrats in California, who has called Trump, “hitler”, fascist and all the usual left wing smear names because of deporting illegal aliens, is now groveling to Trump for fire relief money at the White House? First of all, why the hell did Trump even have this shitbag in the White House at the first place? Secondly, if Trump is “Hitler”, why is Karen Bass standing and smiling with “Hitler”?
Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass (D) shares a picture with Trump in the Oval Office after public spats with the leader last year over immigration riots and the handling of California wildfires.
[https://t.co/fGZAnPR3FH]— Ashleigh Fields (@AshleighFields_)
[April 23, 2026]
Where was this Karen Bass a year ago? She’s not showing up now because she suddenly cares. She wants to save her job in an election year.
I don’t blame President Trump for trying to get help to people who need it desperately. God bless him for it. But the American people…
[https://t.co/mFr70AvjI5]— Rick Scott (@SenRickScott)
[April 23, 2026]
